regulatory.title: data-residency
regulatory.body: Data residency. Company data stays within approved systems: the ERP, the case store, and the approved model endpoint. Operational documents — purchase orders, invoices, shipment notices, dock photos, and board memos — may be processed by the approved model endpoint for transcription, matching, screening, and explanation. HR documents and other restricted records must never be sent to the model and can never ground a rule. Vendor bank details are used only to match and pay the invoice that carries them. Personal data is minimized in every model request, and employee records are never bulk-exported.

regulatory.title: un38-3-summary
regulatory.body: A UN38.3 test summary is required for the cell/battery type (BAT-LI-01: UN38.3 test summary available for the cell/battery type. Source: UN Manual of Tests and Criteria Part III §38.3; IATA lithium battery guidance; 49 CFR 173.185)

regulatory.title: iata-marks
regulatory.body: Lithium-battery marks on outer cartons must be visible and legible (BAT-LI-03: Lithium-battery mark visible and legible on the outer carton. Source: IATA DGR Fig 7.1.C mark; 49 CFR 173.185(c)(3); IMDG SP188 BAT-LI-04: Class 9 diamond and Cargo Aircraft Only handling visible when required. Source: IATA DGR Class 9 handling; 49 CFR 173.185)

operations.title: dock-safety
operations.body: The dock gate is photo-only. Every inbound carton is checked from its photos: the lithium-battery mark must be visible and legible (BAT-LI-03), the Class 9 diamond and Cargo Aircraft Only handling must be visible when required (BAT-LI-04), and any suspected outer damage goes to human review (BAT-LI-05). Photos never set quantities — ordered and received counts come from the ASN and ERP receipt only. An ASN carton missing from every image goes to human review, and illegible labels are re-shot and re-transcribed before any decision. Nothing auto-quarantines on a photo alone: a human decides from the model crops, quarantine flips the lot's inventory status with a paired hold, and putaway plus payment stay blocked until every review on that lot closes.
